name: vphone-cli
one_liner: A command-line tool that boots a full working virtual iPhone inside a window on a Mac, so developers can test iOS apps or study iOS internals without owning a spare physical device.
buyer: A mobile QA engineer or security researcher at an app company who needs many disposable iOS test environments without buying racks of physical iPhones.
business_use_cases: A QA team spins up dozens of virtual iPhones in CI to test an app across iOS versions without a physical device farm.
A security research firm analyzes suspicious apps inside disposable virtual-iPhone sandboxes instead of risking real hardware.
An app dev agency demos client apps running live on a 'virtual device' during remote client calls without shipping hardware.

money_ideas.idea: Wrap it into a hosted CI action offering on-demand virtual iPhones for automated testing, billed by usage
Offer paid setup/consulting for teams wanting a virtual device farm for QA

steal_this: This weekend, wrap it into a CI action that spins up virtual iPhones on demand for automated screenshot testing, and sell it as a usage-billed add-on to app teams.
